image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a wombat standing on grassy ground with scattered dry leaves. The animal has a stocky, barrel-shaped body covered in coarse, greyish-brown fur. Its head is broad and blunt with small dark eyes, rounded ears, and a large, dark, bare nose. Short, powerful limbs are visible, particularly the front left paw which appears to have digging claws. The background is softly blurred vegetation.
